books.title: Thinking in Systems
books.author: Donella H. Meadows
books.description: A primer on stocks, flows, feedback, delays, and the limits of intervening in connected systems.

books.title: The Fifth Discipline
books.author: Peter M. Senge
books.description: Connects systems thinking with mental models, shared vision, and learning together in an organization.

books.title: The Checklist Manifesto
books.author: Atul Gawande
books.description: Examines how short checklists and communication routines support people performing complex work.

books.title: Thinking in Bets
books.author: Annie Duke
books.description: Separates the quality of a decision from its outcome and explores judgment when information is incomplete.

books.title: Noise: A Flaw in Human Judgment
books.author: Daniel Kahneman, Olivier Sibony, and Cass R. Sunstein
books.description: Explores unwanted variation in human judgment and ways to make evaluation processes more consistent.

books.title: Superforecasting
books.author: Philip E. Tetlock and Dan Gardner
books.description: Uses forecasting research to examine probability estimates, updating beliefs, and learning from scored predictions.

books.title: Good Strategy Bad Strategy
books.author: Richard Rumelt
books.description: Distinguishes coherent responses to important obstacles from broad ambitions and lists of goals.

books.title: The Happiness Trap, Second Edition
books.author: Russ Harris
books.description: Introduces acceptance and commitment skills for relating differently to difficult thoughts and acting on personal values.

books.title: Emotional Agility
books.author: Susan David
books.description: Explores recognizing emotions, loosening their hold on behavior, and choosing actions that fit one's values.

books.title: Four Thousand Weeks
books.author: Oliver Burkeman
books.description: Questions the pursuit of total control over time and argues for choosing meaningful commitments within finite limits.

books.title: The Inner Game of Tennis
books.author: W. Timothy Gallwey
books.description: A sports coaching classic exploring attention, self-talk, and the interference that can accompany trying to perform.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.description: A practical framework for changing habits through small actions, cues, and the design of everyday environments.

books.title: Tiny Habits
books.author: BJ Fogg
books.description: Presents a method for starting with small behaviors and building habits around existing routines.

books.title: Make It Stick: The Science of Successful Learning
books.author: Peter C. Brown, Henry L. Roediger III, and Mark A. McDaniel
books.description: Explains retrieval practice, spacing, and other learning approaches while questioning the confidence produced by easy review.

books.title: Range: Why Generalists Triumph in a Specialized World
books.author: David Epstein
books.description: Examines breadth, exploration, and learning across domains, especially when problems are complex and unpredictable.

books.title: The Coaching Habit
books.author: Michael Bungay Stanier
books.description: Offers a question-led approach to everyday leadership conversations, listening, and helping others think through their challenges.

books.title: Radical Candor
books.author: Kim Scott
books.description: A management approach combining personal care with clear feedback and direct discussion of expectations.

books.title: The Culture Code
books.author: Daniel Coyle
books.description: Explores group culture through stories about belonging, shared vulnerability, purpose, and cooperation.

books.title: NSCA's Essentials of Sport Science
books.author: National Strength and Conditioning Association; Duncan French and Lorena Torres Ronda, editors
books.description: Connects training theory, athlete assessment, monitoring, statistics, data management, and communication in applied sport science.

books.title: Science and Practice of Strength Training, Third Edition
books.author: Vladimir M. Zatsiorsky, William J. Kraemer, and Andrew C. Fry
books.description: Explains physiological foundations and practical choices in strength training, including intensity, timing, recovery, and monitoring.

books.title: Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning, Fifth Edition
books.author: National Strength and Conditioning Association; G. Gregory Haff and N. Travis Triplett, editors
books.description: A broad professional reference on body systems, exercise technique, testing, program design, and strength and conditioning administration.

books.title: Periodization of Strength Training for Sports, Fourth Edition
books.author: Tudor O. Bompa and Carlo Buzzichelli
books.description: Presents ways to organize strength training across short and long planning horizons and different sporting demands.
